answer_4.quote: We recruit participants from an educational institution and ensure they are proficient in both languages of interest. Specifically, participants are either bilingual speakers or graduate students pursuing a Translation Studies degree.
answer_4.guideline: You are asked to compare the meaning of English and French text excerpts. ... 3 Compare the meaning of the two sentences by picking one of the three classes: UNRELATED, SOME MEANING DIFFERENCE, NO MEANING DIFFERENCE
